sources.detail: 2,072 RR gamma0 samples and mask decisions independently reproduced exactly. The identified royalty-free Public User License was approved and its exact PDF hash is checked before imagery access.

sources.detail: CONAE permits catalogue search and thumbnails without registration. Numerical product downloads and processing orders require registration, a CONAE agreement and a signed use license.
